pages.quiz:
HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore prices in shops
   B. Plan income and spending wisely
   C. Hide all money underground
   D. Avoid saving forever

2. Which statement about Civilisations in South and Central Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Civilisations in South and Central Africa as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Civilisations in South and Central Africa.
   C. Say Civilisations in South and Central Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Civilisations in South and Central Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Name the president
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Replace the compass rose

4. Which statement about Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya.
   B. Say Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya as rumours only.
   D. Explain Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Mombasa
   C. Nairobi
   D. Nakuru

6. Which statement about French Revolutions is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say French Revolutions never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat French Revolutions as rumours only.
   C. Explain French Revolutions with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing French Revolutions.

7. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Destroying road signs
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

8. Which statement about Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship as rumours only.
   C. Say Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship.

9. Which statement about Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya.
   C. Say Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. Which statement about Kenyans Response to Colonialism is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Kenyans Response to Colonialism with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Kenyans Response to Colonialism.
   C. Treat Kenyans Response to Colonialism as rumours only.
   D. Say Kenyans Response to Colonialism never happens in Kenya.

11. Which statement about Colonial Administration in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Colonial Administration in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Colonial Administration in Africa.
   C. Say Colonial Administration in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Colonial Administration in Africa as rumours only.

12. Which statement about Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Political developments in independent Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Internal conflicts in Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain French Revolutions and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Aligned and Non-Aligned Movements from 1970 to 2020 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. B — Plan income and spending wisely

2. D — Explain Civilisations in South and Central Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. C — Explain symbols used on a map

4. D — Explain Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. C — Nairobi

6. C — Explain French Revolutions with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. D — Obeying laws and caring for public property

8. A — Explain Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. D — Explain Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. A — Explain Kenyans Response to Colonialism with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. A — Explain Colonial Administration in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. A — Explain Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Political developments in independent Africa; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Internal conflicts in Africa; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of French Revolutions; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Aligned and Non-Aligned Movements from 1970 to 2020; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
